# Hetav Shah - Associate AI Engineer

> Hetav Shah is an Associate AI Engineer at ProductSquads and a final-year B.Tech CS student at Adani University specializing in building production-grade Agentic AI solutions, multi-modal RAG pipelines, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, and serverless AI infrastructure on AWS.

## Core Technical Skills
- Agentic AI & RAG: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Vector Databases (pgvector, Qdrant), vLLM, Bedrock
- Languages & Frameworks: Python, TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, NixOS
- Cloud & DevOps: AWS (Cloud Architecting & Developing certified), Docker, Serverless, EventBridge
